jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for financial services. We work with some of America's largest banks, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.

We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast!




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’re joining at an inflection point. Our usage has grown 40x in the last 6 months and our Agent Product and Success team is a high impact group that shapes how customers use and gain value from our product. You will partner closely with customers to guide deployments, support adoption and ensure they have the tools and insight they need to achieve meaningful outcomes. You will work cross functionally with Engineering and Sales to surface customer needs, solve challenges and help shape how our technology performs in real world environments. This role blends relationship management with hands on execution and is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced setting and wants to have a direct impact at a high growth company.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own deployments end-to-end: scope requirements, customize agents, define success metrics, manage the roadmap, and drive customers from signed contract through full production adoption

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to C-suite and senior executives at major financial institutions and banks — shaping AI roadmaps, leading steering forums, and driving the decisions that determine how AI gets deployed across their operations

 - Translate customer requirements into production-grade AI systems — working directly with engineering to build, test, and iterate on agents handling millions of customer interactions

 - Monitor account health through usage telemetry, surface risk early, and execute retention and expansion plays before problems escalate

 - Build durable executive relationships and lead high-stakes conversations around compliance risk, operational redesign, systems integration, and borrower experience transformation

 - Partner with engineering to submit crisp, data-backed product feedback that translates customer friction into roadmap improvements

 - Help define the playbooks, hiring bar, and operating standards that will scale the Agent Success function as Kastle grows
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

We're looking for people who have owned complex, high-stakes engagements and are ready to move from advising on strategy to being accountable for its execution. Strong candidates typically come from one of these backgrounds:

 - Engagement Managers or Senior Consultants from MBB consulting firms who have led enterprise transformation programs and are ready to own outcomes rather than advise on them

 - Former founders and Startup Operators who have built from zero, thrive in ambiguity, and understand what it takes to earn trust with enterprise customers

 - Technical Product Managers who have run complex, multi-stakeholder deployments at product-focused or infrastructure technology companies and want to operate at a higher level of strategic ownership.
   
   


GREAT TO HAVE

 - Are familiar with Agentic AI deployments in large organizations

 - Have experience in a high-growth startup environment

 - Have a bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math or similar fields
   


WHY JOIN KASTLE

 - Opportunity to work with a world class team building a generational company that will redefine how every loan in America is made and managed

 - Competitive Compensation + Meaningful Equity at a high growth company

 - High ownership and direct input on product direction, company culture, and how the ASM function scales

 - Ability to move fast while your work impacting millions of customers. Add a new feature in a few days and ship it to top 10 lenders the next week.




OTHER PERKS AND BENEFITS

 - Robust medical, vision, & dental coverage

 - 401(K) plan offering

 - Paid Company Meals

 - Company offsites to get to know the team

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for consumer lending. We work with some of America's largest banks and mortgage lenders, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $1 billion in transactions and are backed by Y Combinator and Commerce Ventures. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’re joining at an inflection point. Our usage has grown 40x in the last 6 months and our customers view us as their enterprise AI partner and want us to transform their operations across different lines of business. To help support that we are founding our product team and hiring for leaders to own product for one business vertical each. You will start by partnering closely with customers to build new features for our existing originations agents, guide deployments, support adoption and ensure they have the tools and insight they need to achieve meaningful outcomes. Overtime you will own the product strategy, product execution, integrations, and partnerships for the originations vertical to deliver an end-to-end AI originations platform. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the originations product line end to end — roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for both of our AI origination agents

 - Work directly with AI engineers on failure modes, eval criteria, and the judgment calls of autonomy — when the agent acts, when it asks, when it escalates

 - Own deployments of your product: project-manage post-sale implementations, drive customer adoption, and be the reason the exec sponsor's rollout worked

 - Close the loop from field reality back into the roadmap

 - Own originations product marketing.  Positioning, demo narrative, case studies from live deployments.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in product management, or equivalent ownership as a founder, engagement manager, or operator who shipped real product

 - You've built with LLMs hands-on — you can write and critique prompts, reason about evals, and engage engineers on how, not just what

 - A metrics habit: every claim you make about your product traces to instrumentation you made sure existed

 - You've owned customer-facing outcomes, not just internal roadmaps — deployments, implementations, or embedded work with enterprise customers

 - You write persuasively enough that an EVP forwards it internally

 - Comfort in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you build it

Experience in mortgage, lending, or another regulated industry is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you originations faster than we can teach product instinct.



HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Whether our origination agents beat the best human baseline on the same work — conversion, cycle time, touches per file, error rates. Whether customers are live, adopted, and expanding on both agents. 



HOW WE WORK

Small team, high bar. You'll have full ownership of a product line with top 10 lenders live on it from day one. 


Why join Kastle

 - Opportunity to work with a world class team building a generational AI company that will redefine how every loan in America is made and managed

 - Ability to move fast while your work impacting millions of customers. Add a new feature in a few days and ship it to top 10 lenders the next week.

 - Competitive Compensation + Meaningful Equity at a high growth company

 - High ownership and direct input on product direction, company culture, and how the FDE function scales

 

Other Perks and Benefits

 - Covered Health and Wellness Memberships

 - Robust medical, vision, & dental coverage

 - 401(K) plan offering

 - Paid Company Meals

 - Company offsites to get to know the team
